Beregsurany Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Beregsurány, Hungary

Not demolished. Beregsurány's Jewish population grew from 8 in 1840 to a peak of 76 by 1910, before declining to 39 by 1941. The 1944 Orthodox community numbered 43 members (4 taxpayers), with custodian Frenkel Izidor doubling as a farmer; the community's synagogue on Árpád Road is now a private house. Under German occupation, roughly 40,000 Jews - including those from Beregsurány - were deported from the Beregszász Ghetto in a single month, the final transport departing May 29, 1944. This cemetery's oldest tombstone dates to 1831, its newest to 1937.
